title: Engyoji Temple — official bus, ropeway and mountain approach

facts.fact: The temple describes access from JR or Sanyo Himeji by Shinki bus bound for Shosha Ropeway, then the ropeway to the upper station.
facts.excerpt: 神姫バス「書写ロープウェイ行」で終点下車
facts.location: ロープウェイ「書写山麓駅」まで

facts.fact: From the upper ropeway station the approach to Mani-den continues around one kilometre on foot via Nio-mon; the optional shuttle only reaches below Mani-den.
facts.excerpt: 山上駅から摩尼殿までは
facts.location: ロープウェイ「山上駅」から

facts.fact: Mountain admission donation, ropeway and the optional shuttle have separate arrangements; shuttle last departures vary seasonally and can change with passenger conditions.
facts.excerpt: くれぐれも最終時間をよく確認
